SOX = public-company governance and internal controls. Regulation E = unauthorized electronic transfers and consumer protection.
GDPR = broad EU personal-data lifecycle and privacy. FCRA = US consumer credit-reporting data and related rights.
PSD2 = EU payment-services directive. UK Payment Services Regulations = UK implementation with SCA, unauthorized-payment refunds, and Confirmation of Payee.
Fraud Act = substantive fraud offences. ECCTA = organizational failure to prevent fraud benefiting the organization.
PSR = payment security and unauthorized-transaction protection. FSMA = legal basis for APP scam reimbursement regimes.
OLAF, CFPB, SEC, FTC, and the Payment Systems Regulator are bodies—not laws.
